name: Tuttiphon
author: Tuttiphon
description: Similar songs, artist radio and sonic similarity from the sound of your own music files – answered by Tuttiphon's AI sound analysis; plays passed on to Tuttiphon as they happen.

users.reason: To pass the plays of the users assigned to the plugin on to Tuttiphon (listening times, skips, recap)
